description: 'What's on today / tomorrow / this weekend' from the P + c calendar, birthdays and Australian holidays, and opens the Calendar page on the screen you asked (spoken only, not typed). Added 2026-11-09.

command: (what's|what is|what have we got|what do we have|what do I have|what have I got) on (today|tomorrow|this weekend)

variables.here: {% set a = area_id(trigger.device_id) if trigger.device_id else 'bedroom' %}{{ a if a in ['bedroom','kitchen','living_room','guest_bedroom'] else 'bedroom' }}
variables.day: {{ 'weekend' if 'weekend' in s else 'tomorrow' if 'tomorrow' in s else 'today' }}
variables.start: {% set d = today_at('00:00') %}{% if day == 'tomorrow' %}{{ (d + timedelta(days=1)).isoformat() }}{% elif day == 'weekend' %}{% set wd = d.weekday() %}{{ (d + timedelta(days=(5 - wd) if wd < 5 else 0)).isoformat() }}{% else %}{{ now().isoformat() }}{% endif %}
variables.end: {% set d = today_at('00:00') %}{% if day == 'tomorrow' %}{{ (d + timedelta(days=2)).isoformat() }}{% elif day == 'weekend' %}{% set wd = d.weekday() %}{{ (d + timedelta(days=(7 - wd) if wd < 6 else 1)).isoformat() }}{% else %}{{ (d + timedelta(days=1)).isoformat() }}{% endif %}

actions.set_conversation_response: {% set ns = namespace(ev=[]) %}{% for k, v in cal.items() %}{% for e in v.events %}{% set ns.ev = ns.ev + [e] %}{% endfor %}{% endfor %}{% set evs = ns.ev | sort(attribute='start') %}{% set when = {'today':'today','tomorrow':'tomorrow','weekend':'this weekend'}[day] %}{% if not evs %}Nothing on {{ when }}.{% else %}{% set ns2 = namespace(out=[]) %}{% for e in evs[:5] %}{% if 'T' in e.start %}{% set t = as_datetime(e.start) | as_local %}{% set at = t.strftime('%-I') ~ ('' if t.minute == 0 else t.strftime(':%M')) ~ (' am' if t.hour < 12 else ' pm') %}{% set lead = (t.strftime('%A') ~ ' ' if day == 'weekend' else '') ~ 'at ' ~ at %}{% set ns2.out = ns2.out + [(e.summary | replace(' @ ', ' at ') | replace('@', ' at ') | replace(' & ', ' and ')) ~ ' ' ~ lead] %}{% else %}{% set ns2.out = ns2.out + [(e.summary | replace(' @ ', ' at ') | replace('@', ' at ') | replace(' & ', ' and ')) ~ ((' on ' ~ as_datetime(e.start).strftime('%A')) if day == 'weekend' else '')] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ when | capitalize }}: {{ ns2.out | join(', then ') }}.{{ ' And ' ~ (evs | count - 5) ~ ' more.' if evs | count > 5 else '' }}{% endif %}
